jlc3dp.name: JLC3DP
jlc3dp._note: MJF PA12 only. $0.275/g read on the page (effective 2025-08-13) x 1.01 g/cm3 (HP PA12 datasheet) x 1.40 for the 40% US advance tax JLC3DP collects (us-tariff-policy-faq, 2026-03-19). Minimum $1.00 a part before tariff ('From $1.00'). leadDays is build time only; US transit is not published. shippingUsd 0 is a placeholder, not a price: no JLC3DP page gives a US shipping cost, so a JLC3DP order is undercounted by its shipping until someone gets a checkout quote.
